title: pouteria australis
intro:
Pouteria australis, commonly known as the Black Sapote or Black Pouteria, is a tropical tree species native to Central and South America, known for its edible fruit and medicinal properties.

This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of digestive issues, diarrhea, and fever, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pouteria australis are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, act as an antioxidant, and exhibit antiviral and antibacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of Pouteria australis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
